features.title: Create, stop, start and destroy a sandbox a thread works in
features.summary: Creates a sandbox from a git repository, registers its folder as a DSH project so a thread can start in it, routes the folder's files and commands into the sandbox through @dshfiles/sandbox-seams, and stops, starts, keeps for a retention time and destroys it, from the API and the sandbox_* agent tools.
features.currentSurface: agent tools: sandbox_list, sandbox_inspect, sandbox_logs, sandbox_doctor, sandbox_create, sandbox_start, sandbox_stop, sandbox_export, sandbox_set_retention, sandbox_destroy

configuration.constraints: auto uses a container when one is ready and never the unisolated directory provider.
One more create is refused with the count.
0 destroys a sandbox at stop; a sandbox can override it.

failureModes: A folder outside a git repository, or a repository with no commit, is refused with the instruction to commit it first.
A request that does not fit the state (starting a running sandbox) is refused with its current state.
Destroying needs confirmDestroy: true; the last snapshot stays in the project repository and an edited changes worktree is kept.
After a Host restart every sandbox that was running is marked stopped and can be started again; resources with no record are removed.
A failed step is recorded with the step, the detail and the recovery.

externalDependencies.boundary: The git CLI on the Host for the bundle in and the fetch back; hooks off and every object checked.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories in tests/sandboxes.test.ts.

verification.testName: creates a sandbox from a git repository, routes its workspace and registers it as a project
stops and starts a sandbox with its files kept, and refuses a request that does not fit its state
destroys only with confirmDestroy, keeping the last snapshot in the project repository
destroys a sandbox at stop when its retention is zero
marks what was running as stopped when the plugin comes back, and starts it again
refuses a folder outside git, and more sandboxes than the limit, with a way forward
reports each provider with its readiness and the step that fixes it

verification.reason: The plugin has no browser surface yet; its tools are exercised through the Host API in tests/sandboxes.test.ts.

features.title: Copy the project into a sandbox and its changes back with git
features.summary: Copies one commit into the sandbox as a git bundle, and after every agent turn (or on export) fetches the sandbox's whole working tree back as a snapshot commit into refs/dshfiles/sandbox/<id>, checked out in a changes worktree on this machine; the user's own checkout is never touched.
features.currentSurface: agent tool: sandbox_export; automatic after each turn

configuration.constraints: Off copies changes back only on export and stop.

failureModes: A changes worktree with edits of its own is left as it is (held); the snapshot is still fetched.
Only git objects travel back: hooks are off and every object is checked on fetch.

externalDependencies.boundary: git in the sandbox image and on the Host.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories in tests/sandboxes.test.ts.

verification.testName: copies the changes back after a turn and on export, without touching the project checkout

verification.reason: No browser surface: the Host API test drives it end to end against real git repositories and, where an engine exists, a real container.

features.title: Run a sandbox in a hardened Docker or Podman container
features.summary: Keeps each sandbox's workspace in a named volume and runs it in a container with no capabilities, no new privileges, a read-only root, no network, uid 1000 and CPU, memory and process limits; the guest agent is the container's first process and its stdin and stdout are the channel.
features.currentSurface: settings: provider, containerEngine, image, cpus, memoryMb, pids

configuration.constraints: Needs node 22+, git and bash; sandbox_doctor prints the build command.

failureModes: No engine, or no image, is reported by sandbox_doctor with the command that fixes it.
A container left by a Host that died is removed before the next start.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The container test runs only where the engine and the test image exist (SANDBOXES_TEST_IMAGE).

verification.testName: runs a thread workspace in a container with no network, as a non-root user, and copies its changes back

verification.reason: No browser surface: the Host API test drives it end to end against real git repositories and, where an engine exists, a real container.
